notes: Every file has an @2x twin at 640. Frames marked front are pixel-identical to front.png, and the lying frames (fall's last, dizzy's last, getup's first) are identical to each other, so strips chain without a jump. floor_y is where the standing feet meet the floor, in a 320 cell; lying, he reaches about 4 px lower (nearer the camera). walk-left is rendered, not mirrored, so the K E Y B O keycaps read correctly. stride_px is the screen distance one 16-frame walk cycle covers in a 320 cell (planted feet stay flat and still): move him stride_px / 0.667 s = 64.7 px/s at 320, scaled with the cell size. The turn strips start on the walk's frame 0 exactly, so end the cycle on frame 0, then play the turn.

look_grid.about: rows top to bottom look up (+20) to down (-20); columns left to right look screen-left (-80) to screen-right (+80); the body turns and tilts about the hips on planted feet; the eyes lead a little; the centre cell is front.png
